test_manus_files_create: test the litellm acreate_file method to upload a file to the Manus Files API
test_manus_files_retrieve: test the litellm afile_retrieve method to fetch a file by ID from the Manus Files API
test_manus_files_list: test the litellm afile_list method to list all files from the Manus Files API
test_manus_files_delete: test the litellm afile_delete method to delete a file by ID from the Manus Files API
test_manus_files_e2e: test the full Manus Files API lifecycle including create, retrieve, list, and delete operations
